Supreme Court Takes Action Over Remarks Against Judges and CJI

The Supreme Court has taken action in multiple instances involving remarks made against judges and the Chief Justice of India (CJI). The Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA) moved the Supreme Court to initiate contempt proceedings against a lawyer for "unsavoury" remarks against CJI Surya Kant. Separately, the Supreme Court pulled up Shiv Sena leader Sanjay Raut over his remarks concerning the CJI, emphasizing the need for restraint in language. In another development, the CPI(M) and CPI have requested action against Justice GR Swaminathan for his remarks concerning MP Su Venkatesan. The Chief Justice of India also reassigned two cases from a judge's bench, stating they had "turned into PILs."
